overall.summary_for_human: Four specs, all passing after one revision round. Round 1 had two blocking issues: spec_at-risk-admin consumed a `PaymentAttempt.open_failures` scope that spec_smart-retries did not define (now defined and referenced by name), and spec_suspension-timing listened for a 'billing.final_failure' event while spec_smart-retries published 'billing.retries_exhausted' (now unified). What to read first: the RetriesExhausted event contract in spec_smart-retries, because three specs hang off it. One judgement call for you: spec_dunning-emails includes the email copy as AC-6 through AC-8 so you are approving customer-facing wording here, not later. The 'Support visibility' metric is covered by the admin view but is not measurable by code; you will need the support lead's sign-off as stated in the outcome.

gaps.description: No spec records which dunning email was last sent per account, yet the admin view (AC-3 of spec_at-risk-admin) shows 'last email sent'. The admin spec reads it from mailer delivery logs, which is fragile.
gaps.suggested_resolution: Either add a last_dunning_email_at column to the payment_attempts spec's interface, or have the admin spec drop that column from the view. Not blocking: the admin spec's fallback (delivery log) works.
